summary: Retest after aligning REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to same host as frontend (https://biolinks-pro-3.preview.emergentagent.com). All 11 functional endpoints requested by the review pass: /api/health, /api/public/pricing, /api/public/geo, /api/public/coupons/WELCOME20, /api/auth/login (admin flat shape with access_token), /api/auth/me, /api/auth/register (email service with country=BR currency=BRL), /api/billing/checkout (fresh registered user → returns Stripe checkout_url), /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/users, /api/admin/metrics/timeseries (12 months). The 5 remaining preflight-parametrized failures are the SAME infra-level edge ACAO rewrite as iteration_1 (edge returns *.cluster-3.preview.emergentcf.cloud instead of the request Origin) — but because the fix is same-origin (frontend and backend on identical host), the browser skips CORS enforcement entirely, so these are non-blocking. The user's original CORS error is resolved for the real user flow.

minor.issue: Emergent edge still rewrites Access-Control-Allow-Origin to https://biolinks-pro-3.cluster-3.preview.emergentcf.cloud regardless of request Origin. Not user-facing because same-origin requests bypass CORS in the browser. Only matters if the app ever makes cross-origin calls in the future.

action_items: No backend fix required — same-origin alignment resolves the reported CORS bug end-to-end.
If Emergent infra ever forces cross-origin (e.g. different subdomain for API), request infra team to stop rewriting Access-Control-Allow-Origin at the edge.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend CORS (allow_origin_regex='.*', allow_credentials=True) is correct; combined with same-origin frontend, no changes needed.
Login response shape remains FLAT (access_token + email/id/name/role/organization_id/locale siblings). Ensure frontend reads response.access_token and response.email, not response.user.*.
Register requires 'name' + 'company' + 'service' (singular). Frontend must send these keys.

rca_of_the_issue: User's CORS error was caused by frontend (biolinks-pro-3...) calling backend on a different subdomain (bc5385ca-...) where the Emergent edge rewrote ACAO. Fix applied by E1: point REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to the same host the frontend is served on. Confirmed: /api/health, auth login/me/register, public pricing/geo/coupons, billing checkout, admin stats/users/metrics all return 200 with valid data on the same-origin URL. Browser now skips CORS enforcement entirely, so the edge ACAO rewrite is inconsequential.
